categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Adds functional test coverage specifically for P2P outbound connection management, stale-tip outbounds, and peer network diversification.
categories.rationale: Adds automated functional test coverage for autonomous outbound connection logic that previously lacked end-to-end testing, including stale-tip extra connections (#11560) and network-diversified peer management (#27213). While valuable for verifying partition and eclipse resistance mechanisms, it introduces tests rather than fixing active vulnerabilities.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests, but the category explicitly excludes tests that pin the behavior of a specific subsystem (directing P2P tests to p2p instead).
categories.rationale: The category covers general test infrastructure rather than tests of a particular area, explicitly noting that a labeled PR whose tests are about one area belongs to that area instead.
